'''Garalalesh''' in the [[Ergesh language]], or '''swamp skimmers''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], were three-meter swimming predators that ate prey on the surface of [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui's]] swamps using wide mouths.
